title: Larson Scanner
description: Interactive simulation of the iconic Larson Scanner effect - sweeping red lights with fading trails, made famous by Cylon robots and KITT from Knight Rider
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Animation
LED Patterns
Visual Effects
Pop Culture Technology
Alpha Transparency
learningObjectives: Explain how alpha values of 255, 150, 80, and 30 assigned by distance from the active LED produce the fading trail effect
Trace how an index into the 12-element LED array advances and reverses direction at each end of the sweep
Predict how changing the speed slider alters the sweep rate without changing the trail's alpha pattern
Identify the role of the larger semi-transparent circle drawn behind the active LED in creating the glow
Implement a variation by changing the LED count or trail depth and describe the effect on visual persistence
